english:
Killing a <stasis Frozen /> enemy spawns a <stasis Stasis Crystal /> close to where the enemy dies.

Killing a <stasis Frozen /> Boss spawns 2 Stasis Crystals instead.

Has a 0.3 second cooldown between triggers.

source.text:
Upon killing a Frozen Enemy:

Spawns 1 Stasis Crystals.
Bosses spawn 2 Stasis Crystals.
Crystals are spawned close to where the enemy dies.

Incurs a 0.3 second cooldown between triggers.
